descricao: Windows that are commonly observed near darker locations are considered safe and have no reported effects when in close proximity. All active windows in Level 44 display moving images of the Frontrooms, though, it can't be determined if it is precisely synchronized with reality. Attempted verbal and non-verbal communication through these windows has been unsuccessful. This level is classified to be a non-Euclidean space, causing navigation and backtracking to be impractical.
